info.title: DeepLog API
info.description: REST contract for DeepLog 2.0. All dates use ISO 8601 and errors share one envelope.

post.summary: Report a sanitized browser error signal
post.description: Accepts technical metadata only; messages, stack traces, URLs with query strings, and user data are rejected.

put.summary: Create or replace the private profile photo

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Requires the httpOnly refresh cookie plus the matching CSRF cookie value in X-CSRF-Token.

post.summary: Revoke all sessions for the current user
post.description: Requires Bearer authentication, refresh cookie and CSRF header.

204.description: All sessions revoked and cookies cleared

post.description: Always returns the same message to prevent account enumeration. Development may also return resetToken.

get.summary: List private dive locations for the authenticated user
Find past dives with matching equipment

delete.summary: Delete a dive and its private data

put.summary: Create or replace a private reflection

post.summary: Create an expiring share and QR

get.summary: Read data allowed by a share
get.description: Password-protected shares accept their temporary scoped Bearer token.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not owned by the caller

ReflectionInput.description: At least one non-empty text field is required

diveNumber.description: Position in the diver logbook, 1 = oldest dive. Counted over all dives, so filters and pages do not change it. Present on list and detail reads.
